Live Free.name: Live Free
Live Free.description:
🕊️ You want to live by your own rules: no contracts, no rankings, no one telling you how to use your Quirk or your life.

🧭 This motivation shapes the chances the story offers: open roads, odd jobs and people who live outside the system.
⚖️ Freedom has legal and personal costs, and so does obedience. The choice stays yours.
🤝 Expect offers of freedom with conditions: vigilantes, drifters and villain recruiters.
Live Free.traitNarrativeEffects: The character wants freedom: from rules, expectations, contracts, family plans, or a law that says when they may use their own Quirk. The narrator surfaces both sides: open roads, travel, odd jobs and people who live outside the system, and the limits they push against (curfews, licensing law, agency contracts, family expectations, debts). It brings in people who offer freedom with conditions: vigilantes, drifters, villain recruiters and groups that preach unrestricted Quirk use. Pressures: freedom has legal and personal costs, and so does obedience; the narrator shows both. Never push the character toward crime or toward compliance; present the choice and let the player make it.
